request.description: Postman is never a SANCTUM_STATEFUL_DOMAINS origin, so this always returns a bearer `token` (the same path a future mobile app would use) instead of a session cookie. request.description: What a user changes from their own profile: the photo (multipart, POST + _method=PATCH). item.description: FRD V01.14 §1.9 — main services (a category: non_hazardous | hazardous | supplying, with its supported vehicle categories) and sub-services (asset type, compatible capacities, intermediate facilities, recycle-receipt flag, skip colour). System Admin / Data Entry manage; Auditor views/exports; Driver 403. JSON bodies (no files). No delete routes — deactivate instead.

request.description: search matches the main service name AND its sub-services' names (both columns are on screen). service_type: non_hazardous | hazardous | supplying. operational_status: active | deactivated. sort_by: name | service_type | operational_status | created_at. Each row carries sub_services [{id,name,operational_status,asset_type,requires_recycle_receipt,skip_color_code,skip_color_label,skip_color_hex}] and vehicle_categories. The Sub Services accordion page uses this endpoint with per_page/page (10 mains per page by default) + the same search/service_type/operational_status filters. subs_limit=N (max 50) returns only the first N sub-services of each row plus the true sub_services_count (omit it to get all of them); subs_match=1 together with search narrows both to the matching sub-services unless the main service itself matched. search_in = all (default) | main (the main service name only) | sub (its sub-services' names only) limits what search looks at.

item.name: Verification code (OTP) & client reminder
item.description: Phase 3 · part 7.3. A one-time code e-mailed to the account's own address, asked for before the sensitive trip actions (client approve / reject, final approval, cancel, reject a client objection — NOT before creating a completed trip). One code belongs to one login (this session or this API token): once verified it stays valid for OTP_VERIFIED_FOR_MINUTES (default 8 h). Roles: system_admin, data_entry and the two client roles; others get 403. The code is 6 digits, valid 10 minutes, 5 wrong tries, a new one can be asked for after 1 minute (a new code cancels the old one). The trip action that needs it answers 403 with code=otp_required until /otp/verify has succeeded. With MAIL_MAILER=log the code is in storage/logs/laravel.log.

request.description: Mails a fresh code. `purpose` is optional free text shown in the e-mail. 429 + Retry-After if asked again within a minute; 503 code=otp_mail_failed if the mail could not be sent (no code is left waiting). Returns the masked address, the validity and the earliest resend time.
Checks the code. Wrong: 422 with errors.code and the tries left; expired / never sent: 422; locked after 5 wrong tries: 429. On success this login is verified for the configured time.
Whether this login is currently verified, and until when. Lets the UI skip the code dialog.

System Admin / Data Entry only; needs no code. Mails the trip's default client approver, or — if there is none, or they are inactive / on vacation — every active client account that sees the project. 422 code=reminder_not_awaiting if the trip is not awaiting the client's approval; 422 code=reminder_no_recipient if nobody can approve; 429 code=reminder_too_soon (with retry_after_minutes) within an hour of the previous reminder; the reminder is written to the trip history.

item.name: Trips
item.description: Phase 3 · part 7.4 — GCM's trips (FRD trips management). Manage = System Admin / Data Entry; view and export = + Auditor. Part 7.5 opened the list, counters, export, details and files to the client's project manager / auditor (their projects only; see the Client trips folder); the driver's and contractor's come in 7.6–7.7 on the same scope and field rules (ج18). The final approval, rejecting the client's objection and cancelling need the e-mailed code first (Verification code (OTP) folder); creating a completed trip and accepting the objection don't (ج15). Form lists: the Trip form options folder. The examples were taken from the test fixture (company ALN, project Riyadh Hotel, PO ALN-1200).

request.description: The FRD trips table, newest first (sort_by: trip_at | code | status). Filters: date_from / date_to (Y-m-d, the end day included), status (awaiting_client_approval | client_approved | client_issue | completed | cancelled), driver_id, vehicle_id, driver_affiliation / vehicle_affiliation (gcm | contractor), contractor_id (the driver's OR the vehicle's contractor — ج19), company_id, project_id, main_service_id, sub_service_id, purchase_order (linked | none). search: trip No., driver name, plate (as shown or without the space), client, project, sub-service, PO No. Roles: System Admin, Data Entry, Auditor (client / driver / contractor pages come in 7.5–7.7). Each row is a TripResource (see Trip details) without the history and the people of the details page.

item.name: Trip form options
item.description: Phase 3 · part 7.2. The cascading lists of the trip form — each answers "what may be chosen here, given the choices made before it" (FRD trip form; WEEKLY_PLAN 7.2, nine steps). Read-only GET. Roles: System Admin / Data Entry (the staff form) and Driver (his own form); the drivers, POs and default-approver lists are staff only; auditor, client and contractor accounts get 403. The server re-checks every choice when a trip is saved (an available, compatible resource — only for the fields the save changes: an old trip keeps resources that went on vacation / maintenance since), so these lists are a convenience, not the guarantee. Long lists are paged: `search`, `page`, `per_page` (default 20, max 1000); response `{data, meta: {current_page, last_page, per_page, total, …}}`. Any id of another tenant is a 422 like a missing one. The examples were taken from the test fixture (company ALN, project Riyadh Hotel, PO ALN-1200 running + ALN-1100 ended).

request.description: Step 1 of the staff form. Active drivers of GCM or of an active contractor (ج4: a driver on vacation / deactivated, or of a deactivated contractor, is never offered — even for a trip recorded after the fact). `default_vehicle_id` is the driver's default vehicle only while he may take it (available + his category). System Admin / Data Entry only (the driver form shows the driver himself). Paged: `search` (name, code, phone), `page`, `per_page` (default 20).

The vehicles the driver may take: active, of GCM or of an active contractor, and of a category the driver is qualified for — affiliation is NOT a condition (ج4: a contractor's driver may drive a GCM vehicle). `is_default` / `meta.default_vehicle_id` prefill the form. For a driver account `driver_id` is ignored: always his own vehicles. `search` matches the plate as shown ("ABC 1234") or without the space.

request.description: Step 3 + step 9 (cost source). EVERY PO of the project that is not deactivated — running, not started, ended or used up (ب6: the trip is recorded after it happened and may be charged past the balance) — newest first. With `main_service_id`: only the POs covering that service, each with its line's per-trip cost (`trip_cost`, `ancillary_cost` — read-only in the form) and status (`valid` / `near_exhaustion` / `exhausted`), and `is_default` = the PO a trip would be charged to (newest with balance on `trip_at`). `trip_at` (default now) dates the statuses. NO balances (used / remaining / max) — they stay behind /purchase-orders (Data Entry has no PO access). `meta.without_purchase_order_only` = true when the list is empty: the trip goes "without PO" with a hand-entered cost (`cost_source` = manual). item.description: FRD V01.14 §1.13 (Phase 3 · part 6.2). System Admin creates / edits / deactivates; System Admin + Auditor read and export; a client Project Manager reads the POs of their own projects (every amount, no export). Data Entry, client Project Auditor, contractor users and drivers get 403 — Data Entry has NO access to POs at all, not even to view. The PO number is the company short name + the paper contract number (ALN-1200), unique per tenant.

request.description: Genuinely paginated server-side. Each row carries the computed state: `status` (valid / near_exhaustion / exhausted + `status_label`), `timeline` (not_started / running / ended) with exactly one of `days_remaining` / `days_until_start` / `days_since_end` and a translated `days_label`. A client manager only gets the POs of their projects.

The five cards: ACTIVE purchase orders, client companies and projects they cover, trips recorded on them (every trip that is not cancelled — 0 until trips exist), and the total of the cost items (sum of every line's maximum trip cost + ancillary cost; also returned split). Scoped to a client manager's own projects.

System Admin only. paper_number = digits only (up to 10, leading zeros kept); the stored number is the company prefix + "-" + it. The company and project must be active and together; the number must be free (even a deactivated PO keeps its number). `region` is pre-filled from the project when left out. `services[]` = at least one line: main_service_id (active), quota_method (`trips_only` | `trips_and_ancillary`), max_trips, trip_cost, ancillary_cost_per_trip (required for trips_and_ancillary), alert_percent (1–99). Totals (max trips × cost) are computed, never sent. 422 when another active PO of the project already holds one of the services over a shared day, unless that PO's line has run out. Returns the full PO with its state and edit lock (`editability`).

request.description: Same as Create, as multipart/form-data with the optional `attachment` (the paper contract: PDF or image, up to 5 MB, kept on the private disk).

The PO with its lines. Per line: the quota, the computed totals, `status` and `components` (date / trips / trip_cost / ancillary_cost — each with state ok|near|exhausted, used, max, remaining, percent_remaining). `totals` sums the lines. `editability` tells the edit form what is locked: `has_trips`, `editable_fields`, `can_change_services` and per line (`services[].id`) `can_change`, `min_max_trips`, `editable_fields`.

System Admin only. Decision ب2: while no (non-cancelled) trip is recorded on the PO everything can change; once one is, ONLY the quota of the existing lines (max_trips, trip_cost, ancillary_cost_per_trip, alert_percent) — the dates, number, company, project, region, notes, attachment, and the lines themselves lock (422 naming the field). max_trips can never go below the trips already consumed. `services` is the WHOLE list of lines after the edit: an item with `id` edits that line, one without adds a line, a line left out is removed. A new trip cost applies to later trips only. To replace the attachment send multipart with `_method=PATCH`. Deactivating / re-activating is its own endpoint.

System Admin only; allowed with or without trips. status = `active` | `deactivated`. A deactivated PO is not offered for new trips, does not block another PO and does not make its services "in a PO". Re-activating is refused (422 on `status`) when another active PO of the project now holds one of its services over a shared day.
The paper contract from the private disk, behind the same gate as viewing the PO. 404 when none was uploaded.
